containers.name: mymo
containers.description: MyMo app source files, shared across multiple projects/pipelines, not specific to any single one.

containers.name: ToLAKE
containers.description: Shared FTP drop location used by several projects' datalake pipelines, not exclusive to any one pipeline.

containers.name: mymo_register
containers.description: Collects all activities related to MyMo registration, all modes. Data date T-1. Gzipped daily file: MyMo_Register_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz, pipe-delimited, with header, with a companion MyMo_Register_YYYYMMDD.cksum for validation.

containers.name: mymo_changemode
containers.description: Collects all activities related to changing of MyMo modes for a user (from and to), all modes. Data date T-1. Gzipped daily file: MyMo_ChangeMode_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz, pipe-delimited, with header, with a companion MyMo_ChangeMode_YYYYMMDD.cksum for validation.

columns.name: mode_from
columns.description: MyMo Mode before the change: Normal, SecurePlus

columns.name: mode_to
columns.description: MyMo Mode after the change: Normal, SecurePlus

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Channel of the change: MyMo, SUMO
